title: Installation Jobs: Shaped-Trim Adder for Lead-Safe Work
content:
**Shaped and wood builds under lead-safe practices — Installation Jobs**

Shaped units carry more painted trim to work. When the lead-safe fee of an **Installation Jobs** record is priced, a shaped-trim adder per opening on the job follows the build class of the **Factory Production Orders** order the job installs:

| Build class of the factory order | Shaped-trim adder |
|---|---|
| Specialty Shape Build | $12.00 per opening on the job |
| Architectural Wood Build | $8.00 per opening on the job |
| any other build class | none |

The adder is multiplied by the openings on the job and added to the fee.

## Cases (hypothetical jobs)

- A job of 5 openings installing a Specialty Shape Build: 5 multiplied by 12.00, that is 60.00 added.
- A job of 10 openings installing an Architectural Wood Build: 80.00 added.
- A job installing a Custom Color Build or an Impact-Rated Build: nothing added.
